sentences.en: He submitted his resignation in protest of the company's policy.
sentences.zh: 他提交了辞职信以抗议公司的政策。

sentences.en: The company appealed for people to take voluntary resignation.
sentences.zh: 公司呼吁人们自愿离职。

sentences.en: The resignations would have little or no effect on upcoming indications.
sentences.zh: 这些辞职对即将来临的情况影响甚微或根本没有影响。

senses.zh: 辞职，辞呈；顺从，听从；放弃，放弃权利
